KK OK K

ORDER:-

In the Government order first read above, orders have been issued along with guidelines according administrative and financial sanction for a sum of Rs.75,63,00,000/- for “creation of Women Entrepreneurship by providing 5 goats/sheep at 100% subsidy to Rural Poor Widows, Deserted and Destitute Women” during the year 2021-2022.

2. In the letter second read above, the Commissioner of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services has requested the Government to issue necessary amendment to the Government order first read above in order to include “Transgenders” who are otherwise eligible as per the guidelines of the scheme as beneficiaries of the scheme in addition to the Rural Poor Widows, Deserted and Destitute Women ordered in the said Government order.

3. The Government carefully examined the request of the Commissioner of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services and since the overall allocation remains the same, the Government decided to accept.

2

Accordingly, the following amendment is issued to the Government order first read above. AMENDMENT

The Category “Transgenders - who are otherwise eligible as per the guidelines of the scheme” is included as one of the category of beneficiaries under the scheme for “Creation of Women Entrepreneurship by providing 5 goats / sheep at 100% subsidy to Rural Poor Widows / Deserted and Destitute Women” in the orders issued in G.O. (D) No.301, Animal Husbandry, Dairying, Fisheries and Fishermen Welfare (AH2) Department , dated 20.11.2021 and in the Guidelines annexed to the above said Government order.

(BY ORDER OF THE GOVERNOR)

T.S.JAWAHAR ADDITIONAL CHIEF SECRETARY TO GOVERNMENT.
